data.script: const c = pm.iterationData.get('expected_code'), m = pm.iterationData.get('expected_message'); let j = {}; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {} if (c) { pm.test('error = ' + c, () => pm.expect(j.error).to.eql(c)); } if (m) { pm.test('error_description = ' + m, () => pm.expect(j.error_description).to.eql(m)); }
